title: Hood River Distillers Tasting Room

services.name: Tasting Room
services.desc: The Hood River Distillers Tasting Room is a haven for spirits enthusiasts seeking a unique, immersive experience. Nestled in the heart of Hood River, Oregon, this charming and intimate space invites visitors to indulge in the art of local spirits. Our knowledgeable and friendly staff will guide patrons through a curated flight of signature offerings, showcasing the diversity and quality of Hood River Distillers' portfolio. The Tasting Room also offers exclusive releases, mini cocktails, merchandise, and mixers, allowing visitors the opportunity to discover hidden treasures. services.name: ULLR Nordic Libation
services.desc: He is god of snow, Son of Sif, step-son of Thor-he is ULLR, the norse god of skiing. He is so fierce a bowman and ski-runner that none may contend! Just as it is good to invoke his name in duels, it is appropriate when you start a run, go off a kicker, or attack steep moguls. He is who you pray to for snow when the mountains are bare and pay homage to with libation at the end of a day on the mountain. The unique combination of peppermint and cinnamon in ULLR encapsulates the winter sports experience. blurb: Hood River Distillers has a rich and storied history that dates back to 1934. The company initially produced apple and pear brandies, using excess fruit from the valley’s abundant harvests. Over the years, Hood River Distillers expanded its product range to include a diverse array of spirits such as vodka, gin, rum, and whiskey, inspired by the beautiful Pacific Northwest.
